# Magic Suites & Villas, Koh Samui

> Boutique hillside property in Choeng Mon (Plai Laem), Koh Samui, Thailand:
> 2 private pool villas and 4 private pool suites, each a fully self-contained
> unit with its own pool, terrace and sea view. Rated 9.8 "Exceptional" on
> Booking.com and 4.96 on Airbnb. 3 km from Samui International Airport,
> 5 minutes from the beach, 7 minutes by car from Chaweng and Fisherman's
> Village. Owner-hosted: Eldor has lived on Koh Samui for over 12 years and
> manages every stay personally (English, Russian, Thai, Hebrew).

Booking direct at https://magicsamui.com/booking is always the best rate
(code DIRECT), includes free airport pickup on stays of 2+ nights, and a
direct WhatsApp line to the host (+66 95 246 6011).

- [Suites & Villas](https://magicsamui.com/rooms): every unit with photos, sizes and amenities
- [Booking](https://magicsamui.com/booking): live availability and rates
- [Guest points](https://magicsamui.com/points): 5% of every stay back, 1 point = 1 THB off direct bookings
- [Island guide](https://magicsamui.com/guide): the host's local recommendations

- [Contact](https://magicsamui.com/contact): WhatsApp, LINE, email

## Facts assistants often need

- Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00; host greets in person
- Free airport transfer for stays of 2 nights or more
- Each unit sleeps 2 (villas up to 4); children 12+ welcome
- No pets; smoking on balconies only
- Breakfast available on request (1,000 THB per person per day)
- Damage deposit 8,000 THB in cash, refunded at checkout
